item.title: The Gap Between Kernels: Mapping a B200 and Measuring What CUDA Graphs Save
item.description: Learning notes from instrumented experiments on an NVIDIA B200: %globaltimer resolution, deterministic block placement, the GPC map recovered from thread-block clusters, eager launches vs CUDA graphs across kernel lengths and chain lengths, where launch data lives, programmatic dependent launch, and graph update and memory costs. With interactive figures built from the raw data.

item.title: How to Reason About CUDA Streams and Block Admission
item.description: First-principles walkthrough of CUDA streams, the driver's channels and GPFIFOs, and block admission onto SMs, followed by an instrumented two-stream experiment on an NVIDIA B200 with per-block timelines you can explore in the page or in Perfetto.

item.title: Bill Jia on TPUs, Agentic Kernels, and the AI Build-Out
item.description: Notes from a fireside chat with Bill Jia, VP of Engineering for Core ML/AI at Google. Each section separates what Bill said from background context.
